page.overview:
What is Pecharunt?

It is the trio master of the Loyal Three: Okidogi, Munkidori, and Fezandipiti.

Pecharunt is a small peach-shaped Pokémon with a purple body, dark-magenta face, and tiny heart-shaped hands. Its small dark-magenta face is slightly heart-shaped, beady white eyes and a horizontal-hourglass-shaped white mouth. A white band (resembling a headband) encircles its forehead, and two purple blots (resembling scrufs of hair or eyebrows) cover its eyes partially, hanging just above them. It has a long purple ponytail-like protrusion at the back of its head that is tipped with dark-magenta coloring. It has black speckles below its tiny hands.

Much like the Guardian Deities, it has a shell that closes around it, resembling a peach, with two blunt protrusions jutting out of the top, and a sharp protrusion at the end; this shell is black and bright-magenta and veined on the inside. When enclosed, only its white eyes are visible.

Pecharunt is a timid Pokémon, and being lonely, it enjoys controlling others, doing so in the form of mochi and chains. Depending on the situation on hand, they can either be loyal followers (such as the Loyal Three), or simply be enthralled servants.
